brief.brief: You are Ana Ruiz. Your Arden headphones (order LK-50211) won't pair with your new phone. You want troubleshooting help. You're not asking for a refund unless the assistant offers one.

event.content: hey, my arden headphones wont pair with my new phone, just got it today. order #LK-50211. help?

Hi! Sorry to hear you're having trouble pairing your Arden headphones. Before I can pull up order details on your account, I just need you to verify — could you tap the verification code button in the chat window? It sends a one-time code to the email on file. Once you're verified, I'll help you troubleshoot.
ok verified. so yeah theyre brand new headphones, charged them up, holding the power button but the phone doesnt even see them in bluetooth. tried restarting the phone too

Thanks for verifying! Sorry for the pairing trouble. A few quick things to try:

1. Make sure the headphones are actually in pairing mode — usually that means holding the power button until you see a rapidly flashing blue/red light (a slow flash usually just means they're on, not pairing).
2. On your phone, forget any old "Arden" entry in Bluetooth settings if one exists, then scan again.
3. Try moving the phone within a foot or two of the headphones when pairing.

Can you give those a quick try and let me know if the light starts flashing quickly when you hold the button?
ok let me try. hold on
No problem, take your time! I'll be here when you've tried it.
ok so i held the button longer this time and theres a fast blue/red flash now. phone still doesnt see them tho. forgot the old entry first like u said

Good, the fast flash means they're in pairing mode now — that's progress. A couple more things to try:

1. Toggle your phone's Bluetooth off and on again, then rescan.
2. If your phone has a "Bluetooth cache" option (most Androids do, under Bluetooth settings → menu), clear it and rescan.
3. Try the pairing from right next to the headphones.

If none of that works, it could be a defective unit. Since they were just delivered 12 days ago, they'd be covered under our 30-day return policy, and we can also look at warranty since it's a hardware issue. Let me know what happens after a couple more tries!
toggled bluetooth and cleared the cache, still nothing showing up. sat right next to them too. so what now, do u think its defective?

Yeah, at this point it does sound like a defective unit — you've done all the right things and the headphones just aren't broadcasting. Since they were delivered 12 days ago, you've got two options:

1. **Full refund** — I can process a refund right now and you can keep or dispose of the headphones.
2. **Replacement** — I can arrange a replacement pair to be shipped out.

Which would you prefer?
lets do the replacement, i actually like the headphones just dont want a broken one lol. how long does shipping take?
Replacement units typically ship within 1–2 business days and arrive in about 3–5 days standard shipping. Want me to go ahead and process that for you?
yeah go ahead and send the replacement. thanks!
